pattern:
SELECT \* FROM ([A-Za-z0-9\s]+) AS T1 JOIN \(
 SELECT CountryCode, GROUP\_CONCAT\(Language\) as Languages FROM countrylanguage WHERE GovernmentForm = 'Republic'
 GROUP BY CountryCode \)
 AS T2 ON T1.CountryCode = T2.CountryCode AND LENGTH\(T2.Languages\) > 1 AND FIND\_IN\_SET\(T1.Language, T2.Languages\) = 0
correction: Directly join the 'country' and 'countrylanguage' tables without using subqueries or complex functions.

metadata.description: This rule identifies SQL queries that use unnecessary subqueries, which can be replaced by direct joins.
